description: Add one task to a board and return its id, board and column. The board is created on first use, so pass an existing project or leave it out. An identical open task is refused. Free: 3 boards, 200 open.

column.description: Column to start in; defaults to the first column (backlog)

estimate_minutes.description: How long you think it will take, in minutes

project.description: Project or board name. A partial name matching exactly one existing project is used as that project. Defaults to your only board.

title.description: What the task is, e.g. 'Write the launch email'

name: task_add
title: Add task
